items.period: Shang-style oracle script; the Commons page does not date an individual inscription specimen
items.tradition: Oracle-bone script style; modern vector drawing
items.caption: A modern vector rendering of 見 in Shang oracle-script style. The form is described as combining an eye and a person.
items.alt: Modern black line drawing of an oracle-style 見 glyph, with a prominent eye shape above a kneeling-person-like lower form.
items.selection_reason: Shows the source-described person-and-eye design associated with the ancient graph; the file page identifies the J20938 source example and states public-domain reuse for the vector.
items.rights: Public domain as stated on the Wikimedia Commons file page; attribution appreciated.

items.period: Bronze-script style; the Commons page does not date an individual inscription specimen
items.tradition: Bronze inscription script style; modern vector drawing
items.caption: A modern vector rendering of 見 in bronze-script style, offered for comparison with the oracle-style form.
items.alt: Modern black line drawing of a bronze-script-style 見 glyph, with an eye over a human-like lower element.
items.selection_reason: Provides a second form in the graph’s documented bronze-script category, illustrating a comparison across source-labelled styles without implying a precise transition date.
items.rights: Public domain as stated on the Wikimedia Commons file page; attribution appreciated.

limitations.text: These assets are modern vector redrawings of historical script styles, not photographs or direct facsimiles of the cited oracle-bone and bronze specimens. Captions should preserve that distinction.
Commons attributes the model examples to the Richard Sears Chinese Etymology data; the image descriptions do not provide specimen dates for those models.
